lines.text: What if some arrows refuse to turn, no matter how hard you push?
A matrix takes every vector in the plane and moves it somewhere else. Most of them change direction. A few don't.
A times v equals lambda times v. The matrix only stretches this vector. It never rotates it.
And that's the whole idea. An eigenvector is simply a direction the transformation leaves alone.
Next time, we'll see why these special directions are everywhere.
